name: event_id
description: UUID per row; the insertId for best-effort dedup on retries

name: event_ts
description: UTC time the row was written (server time). Partition column

name: domain
description: Which part of the portal wrote it: release | deploy | support | watch | cost | notification

name: event_type
description: The domain's verb, e.g. release: queued | withdrawn | released | pending | abandoned; deploy: merged | finished; watch: finding | cleared | dismissed | checked; notification: created | updated | read | dismissed

name: subject
description: What the row is about, one stable key per thing: chart:<name> | incident:<id> | notification:<id> | watcher. Clustering column: every reader filters on it

name: subject_version
description: The subject's version where it has one: a chart's tag, an incident's business date (YYYY-MM-DD); empty otherwise

name: actor
description: The verified email of who caused the row; 'watcher' / 'portal' for rows the app wrote by itself; empty when identity is off - never a typed email

name: recipient
description: Who the row is FOR (notifications): the verified email the bell filters on. Clustering column

name: scope
description: Update-in-place key: one notification thread (release-pr:42) or one watcher incident per date; later rows with the same scope describe the same thing

name: status
description: The subject's state after this row, in the domain's words: notification unread | read | dismissed; watch open | cleared | dismissed

name: severity
description: info | warning | critical for notifications; the incident priority (P1..P4) for watch rows; empty otherwise

name: title
description: One line a person reads: the notification headline, the incident title, the release name

name: body
description: The longer text: a notification's second line, the watcher's answer, a person's own words (capped - never a full model transcript)

name: link
description: Where a click goes: a PR / Actions run URL, or a portal action (portal:queue, chat:<message>)

name: repo
description: GitHub repo the row concerns, owner/repo

name: pr_number
description: Release / promotion / deploy PR number, when the row is about one

name: environment
description: uat | prd | prl1 | dataflow-uat for deploy rows; empty otherwise

name: jira
description: The JIRA the row carries, as typed

name: model
description: Model that wrote the finding; empty when no model was involved

name: model_calls
description: Model calls the row's work took

name: seconds
description: Seconds the row's work took

name: prl1_only
description: Release/deploy: the chart goes to PRL1 only

name: df_only
description: Release/deploy: the artefact is a Dataflow image

name: build_verified
description: Release/deploy: the build and its controls were verified; empty = not checked

name: build_run_url
description: Release/deploy: the Actions run that built the tag

name: target_envs
description: Release/deploy: environments intended, ordered by the promotion chain, e.g. 'uat,prl1,prd'

name: allowed_failures
description: Release/deploy: controls that failed but were allowed, comma separated

name: note
description: Release/deploy: the person's note, as typed

name: run_id
description: Deploy: the GitHub Actions run id

name: run_url
description: Deploy: the Actions run URL

name: workflow
description: Deploy: the workflow name of the run

name: conclusion
description: Deploy: success | failure | cancelled | still_running

name: merge_sha
description: Deploy: the commit a merged PR produced; the runs it started carry the same head_sha

name: chg
description: Deploy: change-request ticket id found on the PR, as written

name: rmg
description: Deploy: release-management ticket id found on the PR, as written

name: chg_state
description: Deploy: the change ticket's state word on its line (created | approved | ...)

name: rmg_state
description: Deploy: the release ticket's state word on its line

name: category
description: watch: the incident's category; notification: its kind (release_pr | uat_pr | df_run | requeue | chg | deploy_started | deploy_finished | auto_triage)

name: count
description: Watch: rows (or jobs) the incident covers

name: owner
description: Watch: who owns the incident per the runbook

name: runbook
description: Watch: the runbook entry it matched

name: cause
description: Watch: the cause the investigation found

name: established
description: Watch: whether the evidence established the cause

name: action
description: Watch: what to do now

name: action_why
description: Watch: why that action

name: fallback
description: Watch: the finding is the model-free one

name: notified
description: Watch: a notification went out for this finding

name: business_date
description: Watch: the business date of the incident

name: incident_id
description: Watch: the incident id within its business date

name: details
description: JSON text for long overflow only (a timeline, a proposal) - never a field a query filters on
